Reward Design Function - análisis visual preservando el espíritu del notebook anterior¶

Este notebook vuelve al objetivo del diseño original: entender la reward visualmente con mapas de calor, perfiles y distribuciones de comportamiento conjunto.

La diferencia es que ahora todo queda alineado con la implementación vigente del sistema:

  • la reward principal nace de métricas interval-level L_*_<var_obj>
  • los extras activos son bandwidth_bonus y dynamic_penalty
  • la asignación final es por lazo (controller_reward)

Para conservar la intuición visual del notebook previo, se usan dos vistas complementarias:

  1. vista exacta en el espacio de métricas: mapas sobre L_e, L_edot, L_delta_u
  2. vista proxy en el espacio de comportamiento: mapas sobre |error| y |control_action|

Esa segunda vista asume intervalos cuasi estacionarios, lo que permite proyectar la reward actual sobre ejes comparables a los que motivaban el notebook anterior.

def get_range_abs(var_obj, feature_key):
    cfg = normalization_cfg["params"][var_obj][feature_key]
    lo, hi = cfg["range"]
    return max(abs(lo), abs(hi))


def normalized_metric_from_constant_level(var_obj, feature_key, level):
    cfg = normalization_cfg["params"][var_obj][feature_key]
    method = cfg["method"]
    lo, hi = cfg["range"]
    out_lo, out_hi = normalization_cfg["output_limits"]

    arr = np.asarray(level, dtype=float)
    abs_arr = np.abs(arr)

    if method == "mean_squared":
        span = max(abs(lo), abs(hi)) ** 2
        normalized_01 = np.square(abs_arr) / span if span > 0 else np.zeros_like(abs_arr)
    elif method in {"abs", "rms"}:
        span = max(abs(lo), abs(hi))
        normalized_01 = abs_arr / span if span > 0 else np.zeros_like(abs_arr)
    else:
        span = hi - lo if hi != lo else 1.0
        normalized_01 = np.abs(arr - lo) / span

    normalized_01 = np.clip(normalized_01, 0.0, 1.0)
    return out_lo + normalized_01 * (out_hi - out_lo)


def principal_loop_reward(var_obj, error_level, edot_level, I_level=0.0, delta_u_eff_level=0.0):
    L_e = normalized_metric_from_constant_level(var_obj, "e", error_level)
    L_edot = normalized_metric_from_constant_level(var_obj, "edot", edot_level)
    L_I = normalized_metric_from_constant_level(var_obj, "I", I_level)
    L_delta_u = normalized_metric_from_constant_level(var_obj, "delta_u", delta_u_eff_level)

    if principal_cfg["method"] == "lineal_combination":
        return (
            -principal_features["L_e"]["weight"] * L_e
            -principal_features["L_edot"]["weight"] * L_edot
            -principal_features["L_I"]["weight"] * L_I
            -principal_features["L_delta_u"]["weight"] * L_delta_u
        )

    result = np.zeros_like(np.asarray(L_e, dtype=float))
    values = {
        "L_e": L_e,
        "L_edot": L_edot,
        "L_I": L_I,
        "L_delta_u": L_delta_u,
    }
    for feature_name, value in values.items():
        params = principal_features[feature_name]
        result -= params["weight"] * (
            1.0 - np.exp(-params["scaled"] * (value - params.get("setpoint", 0.0)) ** 2)
        )
    return result


def get_band_range(var_obj):
    return band_cfg["ranges"][f"error_{var_obj}"]


def band_bonus_interval(var_obj, error_level, accumulated=0.0):
    band_lo, band_hi = get_band_range(var_obj)
    error_abs = np.abs(np.asarray(error_level, dtype=float))
    band_limit = max(abs(band_lo), abs(band_hi))
    in_band = error_abs <= band_limit
    raw_bonus = np.where(in_band, decision_steps * band_cfg["per_step_band_bonus"], 0.0)
    max_total = band_cfg["max_total_band_bonus"][var_obj]
    return np.minimum(raw_bonus, np.maximum(0.0, max_total - accumulated))


def dynamic_penalty_interval(var_obj, control_action_level, error_level):
    if not dyn_pen_cfg["enabled"]:
        return np.zeros_like(np.asarray(control_action_level, dtype=float))

    signal_name = f"control_action_{var_obj}"
    cfg = dyn_pen_cfg["dynamic_penalty_params"].get(signal_name)
    if cfg is None:
        return np.zeros_like(np.asarray(control_action_level, dtype=float))

    signal_abs = np.abs(np.asarray(control_action_level, dtype=float))
    error_abs = np.abs(np.asarray(error_level, dtype=float))
    cond = cfg["condition"]
    cond_factor = np.exp(-cond.get("scaled", 1.0) * (error_abs - cond.get("setpoint", 0.0)) ** 2)

    if dyn_pen_cfg["method"] == "lineal":
        return -cfg["weight"] * signal_abs * cond_factor
    return -cfg["weight"] * (signal_abs ** 2) * cond_factor


def total_loop_reward_proxy(var_obj, error_level, control_action_level, edot_level=0.0, I_level=0.0, delta_u_eff_level=0.0):
    principal = principal_loop_reward(var_obj, error_level, edot_level, I_level, delta_u_eff_level)
    band = band_bonus_interval(var_obj, error_level)
    dyn_pen = dynamic_penalty_interval(var_obj, control_action_level, error_level)
    return principal + band + dyn_pen


def plot_heatmap(ax, x_axis, y_axis, z_values, x_label, y_label, title, cmap, colorbar_label):
    image = ax.imshow(
        z_values,
        extent=[x_axis.min(), x_axis.max(), y_axis.min(), y_axis.max()],
        origin="lower",
        aspect="auto",
        cmap=cmap,
    )
    ax.set_xlabel(x_label)
    ax.set_ylabel(y_label)
    ax.set_title(title)
    plt.colorbar(image, ax=ax, label=colorbar_label)


def build_summary_tables():
    principal_df = pd.DataFrame(principal_features).T.rename_axis("feature").reset_index()
    extra_status_df = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {"block": "bandwidth_bonus", "enabled": band_cfg["enabled"]},
            {"block": "dynamic_penalty", "enabled": dyn_pen_cfg["enabled"]},
            {"block": "dynamic_incentive", "enabled": extra_cfg["conditional_approach"]["dynamic_incentive"]["enabled"]},
            {"block": "goal_bonus_reward", "enabled": extra_cfg["bonus_approach"]["goal_bonus_reward"]["enabled"]},
            {"block": "penalty_delta_var", "enabled": extra_cfg["penalty_approach"]["penalty_delta_var"]["enabled"]},
            {"block": "penalty_instantaneous_reward", "enabled": extra_cfg["penalty_approach"]["penalty_instantaneous_reward"]["enabled"]},
        ]
    )
    band_df = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "var_obj": var_obj,
                "band_abs_max": abs(get_band_range(var_obj)[1]),
                "per_step_bonus": band_cfg["per_step_band_bonus"],
                "interval_bonus_if_full_band": decision_steps * band_cfg["per_step_band_bonus"],
                "max_total_band_bonus": band_cfg["max_total_band_bonus"][var_obj],
            }
            for var_obj in active_var_objs
        ]
    )
    dyn_pen_df = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "var_obj": var_obj,
                "signal": f"control_action_{var_obj}",
                "weight": dyn_pen_cfg["dynamic_penalty_params"][f"control_action_{var_obj}"]["weight"],
                "condition_feature": dyn_pen_cfg["dynamic_penalty_params"][f"control_action_{var_obj}"]["condition"]["feature"],
                "condition_scaled": dyn_pen_cfg["dynamic_penalty_params"][f"control_action_{var_obj}"]["condition"].get("scaled", 1.0),
                "condition_setpoint": dyn_pen_cfg["dynamic_penalty_params"][f"control_action_{var_obj}"]["condition"].get("setpoint", 0.0),
            }
            for var_obj in active_var_objs
            if f"control_action_{var_obj}" in dyn_pen_cfg["dynamic_penalty_params"]
        ]
    )
    agent_map_df = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {"agent_name": agent_name, "var_obj": var_obj}
            for agent_name, var_obj in reward_calculator.agent_to_var_obj_map.items()
        ]
    )
    return principal_df, extra_status_df, band_df, dyn_pen_df, agent_map_df


def build_synthetic_interval(n_steps=decision_steps):
    records = []

    theta_error = np.linspace(0.18, 0.04, n_steps)
    theta_edot = np.linspace(-0.15, -0.03, n_steps)
    theta_I = np.linspace(0.010, 0.040, n_steps)
    theta_u_eff = np.linspace(0.25, 0.08, n_steps)
    theta_u = np.linspace(0.35, 0.10, n_steps)

    x_error = np.linspace(0.03, 0.005, n_steps)
    x_edot = np.linspace(-0.08, -0.01, n_steps)
    x_I = np.linspace(0.003, 0.012, n_steps)
    x_u_eff = np.linspace(0.10, 0.03, n_steps)
    x_u = np.linspace(0.12, 0.04, n_steps)

    theta_delta_u_eff = np.diff(np.concatenate([[theta_u_eff[0]], theta_u_eff]))
    theta_delta_u = np.diff(np.concatenate([[theta_u[0]], theta_u]))
    x_delta_u_eff = np.diff(np.concatenate([[x_u_eff[0]], x_u_eff]))
    x_delta_u = np.diff(np.concatenate([[x_u[0]], x_u]))

    u_total = theta_u_eff + x_u_eff
    delta_u_total = np.diff(np.concatenate([[u_total[0]], u_total]))

    for idx in range(n_steps):
        records.append(
            {
                "error_pendulum_angle": float(theta_error[idx]),
                "derivative_error_pendulum_angle": float(theta_edot[idx]),
                "integral_error_pendulum_angle": float(theta_I[idx]),
                "u_eff_pendulum_angle": float(theta_u_eff[idx]),
                "delta_u_eff_pendulum_angle": float(theta_delta_u_eff[idx]),
                "control_action_pendulum_angle": float(theta_u[idx]),
                "delta_control_action_pendulum_angle": float(theta_delta_u[idx]),
                "error_cart_position": float(x_error[idx]),
                "derivative_error_cart_position": float(x_edot[idx]),
                "integral_error_cart_position": float(x_I[idx]),
                "u_eff_cart_position": float(x_u_eff[idx]),
                "delta_u_eff_cart_position": float(x_delta_u_eff[idx]),
                "control_action_cart_position": float(x_u[idx]),
                "delta_control_action_cart_position": float(x_delta_u[idx]),
                "u_total": float(u_total[idx]),
                "delta_u_total": float(delta_u_total[idx]),
            }
        )

    return records

1. Reward principal por lazo en el espacio de métricas¶

Aquí miramos la reward principal en su dominio exacto: métricas ya agregadas por intervalo.

Como la agregación actual es mean_squared, la reward principal es simétrica respecto al signo. Por eso los mapas se muestran en términos de magnitud: |error| y |derivative_error|.

2. Extras activos por lazo¶

El notebook viejo dedicaba mucha intuición visual a zonas de premio y castigo. Aquí se conserva eso, pero usando las reglas activas reales:

  • bandwidth_bonus: banda favorable en el error
  • dynamic_penalty: penalización de la acción de control modulada por el error

display(Markdown("## 2A. Heatmaps del dynamic penalty + perfil del bandwidth bonus"))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, len(active_var_objs), figsize=(6 * len(active_var_objs), 8), constrained_layout=True)
if len(active_var_objs) == 1:
    axes = np.array([[axes[0]], [axes[1]]])

for col, var_obj in enumerate(active_var_objs):
    error_axis = np.linspace(0.0, get_range_abs(var_obj, "e"), 260)
    action_axis = np.linspace(0.0, get_range_abs(var_obj, "u"), 260)
    ERROR, ACTION = np.meshgrid(error_axis, action_axis)

    dyn_pen = dynamic_penalty_interval(var_obj, ACTION, ERROR)
    plot_heatmap(
        axes[0, col],
        error_axis,
        action_axis,
        dyn_pen,
        x_label=f"|error_{var_obj}|",
        y_label=f"|control_action_{var_obj}|",

    axes[1, col].axvspan(0.0, band_hi, alpha=0.18)

3. Reward total proxy en el espacio de comportamiento¶

Esta es la parte que más se parece al notebook anterior.

Para visualizar cómo se comporta la reward frente a variables “intuitivas”, suponemos un intervalo cuasi estacionario: el error medio, la derivada media y la acción media se mantienen aproximadamente constantes dentro de ese intervalo.

Bajo ese supuesto, la reward total por lazo queda:

principal_loop_reward + bandwidth_bonus + dynamic_penalty

y puede dibujarse como mapas de calor sobre |error| y |control_action|.

5. Check end-to-end con la API actual¶

Los gráficos anteriores son útiles para diseñar intuición. Aquí cerramos el loop con una pasada real por MetricProcessing y RewardCalculatorBase para que el notebook siga anclado a la implementación verdadera.
